description: Données Ouvertes sur les Digues et Petits Barrages au Togo is a data set listed in Togo national open data portal (opendata.gouv.tg), a national open data portal, published or maintained by Ministère de l'Agriculture, de l’Hydraulique et du Développement Rural . Les digues et petits barrages sont des infrastructures essentielles pour la gestion de l'eau au Togo, particulièrement dans les zones rurales et agricoles. Ces données décrivent la localisation, la capacité, et l'état des digues et barrages à travers le pays. Coverage: Togo. The portal files it under the publisher Ministère de l'Agriculture, de l’Hydraulique et du Développement Rural . Its tags are barrages, digues. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2025-01-09 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is other open licence as labelled on the portal (terms not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support dam, reservoir and flood defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-tg-portal.
